configurations.name: harmonic-demo
runtimeArgs: HARMONIC_DB=$PWD/tconnect-data/ciq.demo.db HARMONIC_API_TOKEN=secret HARMONIC_SECRET_KEY=$PWD/tconnect-data/secret.key TIMEZONE_NAME=${TIMEZONE_NAME:-UTC} uv run --extra api --extra sync python .claude/qa/demo_serve.py

configurations.name: harmonic-nofetch
runtimeArgs: scratch="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harmonic-qa-e2e.sqlite"; rm -f "$scratch" "$scratch-wal" "$scratch-shm" "$scratch.derived.sqlite"; cp mockups/qa-e2e.synthetic/harmonic.sqlite "$scratch"; exec uv run harmonic serve --no-fetch --token '' --db "$scratch" --port 8765
